work_step: Access and work on elevated platform
standard_controls: Use approved working platform with guardrails, toe boards, safe access, pre-use inspection, exclusion zone below and task briefing.
competent_person_required: Competent person inspection for scaffold / platform where applicable
inspection_points: Platform condition, access, guardrails, housekeeping, weather and supervision
common_mistakes: Generic training wording without platform-specific inspection and access controls
legal_reference_tags: To be verified by Safety Officer

consequence: Crush injury, fatality or property damage
standard_controls: Confirm lifting plan, lifting gear certificate, competent operator / rigger, exclusion zone, tag line where safe, communication method and weather limits.
permit_required: Lifting permit / checklist where required by project procedure
competent_person_required: Competent lifting supervisor / rigger / operator as applicable
inspection_points: SWL, certificates, ground condition, load path, exclusion zone and communication
common_mistakes: Controls do not state lifting plan, certificates or exclusion zone
legal_reference_tags: Lifting Appliances and Lifting Gear Regulations
To be verified by Safety Officer
